claim: 2026 adult (12-64) online tickets range from €43 to €52 depending on day/season; children (3-11) from €37 to €46; seniors (65+) from €41 to €50; under-3s free; ticket-office purchase costs €5 more than online.
quote: Tickets to Pairi Daiza for adults aged 12 to 64 years are available online from €43 ... maximum of €52 depending on day/season. Children (3-11): from €37 ... maximum €46. Seniors (65+): from €41 ... maximum €50.

claim: Twelve 'Journées du Cœur' offer a flat €25 entry rate regardless of age, and access to the Edenya tropical greenhouse requires a separate €7 ticket with time-slot reservation.
quote: Journées du Cœur: Twelve designated days throughout the year offer all visitors a flat rate of €25 regardless of age or status. Edenya: an additional €7 fixed price ticket required for entry (separate from park admission).

claim: The Pairi Daiza 2026 season runs from 7 February 2026 to 31 January 2027, with calendar pricing tiers of €25, €43, €49 and €52.
quote: Open from 07 February 2026 to 31 January 2027 ... calendar legend showing different ticket price tiers (€25, €43, €49, €52)

claim: Pairi Daiza covers 75 hectares (190 acres) on the former Cambron Abbey grounds in Brugelette, houses over 7,000 animals, and opened in 1993 as a bird garden named Paradisio before rebranding in 2009.
quote: Pairi Daiza is situated in Brugelette, Belgium, occupying 75 hectares (190 acres) on the former Cambron Abbey grounds ... over 7,000 animals ... was opened in 1993 as a bird garden named Paradisio, later rebranding to Pairi Daiza in 2009.

claim: Pairi Daiza spans 75 hectares with more than 7,500 animals across 800 species in nine themed worlds, holds a Michelin Green Guide three-star rating, and has been named 'Best Zoo in Europe' multiple times; the affiliated foundation runs 20+ conservation projects.
quote: more than 7,500 animals ... 800 animal species distributed throughout nine themed worlds ... multiple times been awarded the title 'Best Zoo in Europe' ... 'Three Stars' certification in the Michelin Green Guide ... more than 20 projects currently underway

claim: Edenya, Pairi Daiza's tenth themed world, opened 7 February 2026 as the world's largest tropical greenhouse per Guinness World Records: 4 hectares under a 24-metre-high glass roof, 230 animal species, 1,800 plant species and 88 habitats, with a 17-metre indoor waterfall.
quote: Guinness World Records has recognised it as the biggest tropical greenhouse in the world ... 24-metre-high glass roof and spans four hectares ... approximately 230 animal species and 1,800 plant species across 88 different habitats ... 17-metre waterfall.

claim: Edenya cost €215 million to build, features jaguars, manatees, giant otters and Komodo dragons, and is powered by solar panels with insulation five times better than a normal greenhouse.
quote: The project cost €215 million ... houses jaguars, manatees, giant otters, monkeys, and Komodo dragons ... special glass roof insulation performs 'five times better than a normal greenhouse' ... solar panels supply all electricity needs.

claim: The Pairi Daiza Resort has 209 themed lodges (Manatee Cove, Jaguar Falls, Shark Cove, White Bear House, Walrus House, Penguin House, etc.) with 88 new units added for 2026 inside Edenya including underwater rooms; guests get park access for arrival and departure days plus early entry from 09:00, breakfast and 3-course dinner included.
quote: 209 uniquely designed lodge accommodations ... Access to the Park, from the day of your arrival to the day of your departure ... exclusive early Park access from 9:00 AM, one hour before day visitors ... Breakfast for the whole family (American buffet) ... Evening meal (3 courses)

claim: When 2026 reservations opened, Pairi Daiza Resort recorded 3,976 bookings in 24 hours for the 7 February 2026–2 January 2027 season — a new record.
quote: Within 24 hours after reservations opened for the 2026 season, from February 7, 2026 to January 2, 2027, the Pairi Daiza Resort recorded 3,976 bookings.

claim: Pairi Daiza is rated 4.4/5 across 12,755 Tripadvisor reviews and ranks #1 of 6 things to do in Brugelette; common praise covers theming, cleanliness and animal welfare, while complaints note premium pricing, €13 parking and ongoing construction.
quote: Overall Rating: 4.4 of 5 bubbles (12,755 reviews) ... Ranking: #1 of 6 things to do in Brugelette ... 'The animals, their habitats, the scenery, the cleanliness, Edenya... From start to the end, it was all just magnificent'

claim: Pairi Daiza sits between Mons and Ath in Hainaut, with the park entrance about 1.2 km (a 20-minute walk) from Cambron-Casteau railway station on the Mons–Ath line; motorway access is via A8/E429 (exit 26 Enghien from Brussels or exit 30 Ath from Tournai).
quote: Pairi Daiza is located near Cambron-Casteau station, on the Mons-Ath railway line. The distance between the station and the park entrance is 1.2 km (about a 20-minute walk) ... A8/E429 motorway ... exit 26 (Enghien) ... exit 30 (Ath).

claim: Mons to Pairi Daiza is about 19 km (12 miles) and roughly a 21-minute drive, placing the park about 25 km from Baudour (which lies ~10 km west of Mons).
quote: The distance between Mons and Pairi Daiza is 12 miles, and it takes approximately 21 minutes to drive from Mons to Pairi Daiza.

claim: Pairi Daiza's official 2025 press kit is titled 'VOTED BEST ZOO IN EUROPE 2024'; the park was named best European zoo for 2023 and 2024 by German tourist specialists, ahead of Loro Parque (Spain) and Leipzig Zoo (Germany), and has been awarded the title five times overall.
quote: VOTED BEST ZOO IN EUROPE 2024 PRESS KIT 2025 ... Pairi Daiza was awarded 'Best Zoo in Europe' for the second time by German tourist specialists ... named the best European Zoo for 2023 and 2024, ahead of other renowned zoos such as Loro Parque (Spain) and Leipzig Zoo (Germany).

claim: The Brussels Times covered a behind-the-scenes preview of Edenya, framing it as Pairi Daiza's new tropical world and the centrepiece of the 2026 season.
quote: Walking through Edenya: a behind-the-scenes glimpse at Pairi Daiza's new tropical world
